Animal encounters and Meet The Keeper Talks available as event add-ons

blurb: Guests can host private events such as company picnics, kids' birthday parties, wedding receptions, holiday parties, or rent the entire zoo for private access. Event packages include venue rental, catering, zoo admission, and event support. Animal encounters and entertainment options are available as add-ons for events.
extraNote: Events must be booked at least two weeks in advance · 50% deposit required to reserve picnic or event venue · Final guest count due 7 business days before event; final payment due 5 business days before event · Birthday party rentals and passes are non-refundable and non-transferrable · No events on federal holidays, spring break, or winter break due to crowds · Zoo Lights events not held during Thanksgiving or last two weeks of December · Year-round except federal holidays, spring break, and winter break for events; Zoo Lights mid-November to mid-December and first weekend in January
